Two Realms: Whispers from the Rift

name: Two Realms: Whispers from the Rift
storyline:
Tobias and his younger brother Juno live a quiet life - until a mysterious crystal and a foreboding mage shatter it forever. After their encounter, Juno falls gravely ill, as if his very life force has been drained away.

Forced onto a quest he never chose, Tobias sets out in desperation to save his brother.

The kingdom's capital offers a glimpse of hope - Tobias's sister, a gifted healer living there, could help, and the Citadel's library may hold a sliver of vital knowledge. But as the terrifying mage closes in and unsettling whispers echo in Tobias’s mind, it becomes clear that time is running out.
summary: Fantasy Point & Click Horror Drama: A burst of light - a crystal devours your little brother's life force. Desperate to save him, you seek the truth of magic’s birth, while a dread mage closes in to tear the crystal from your hands - and with it, all hope.
